hints.title: Linear Condition Rewrite
hints.text: The condition prices[j] - prices[i] = j - i can be rearranged into prices[j] - j = prices[i] - i.

hints.title: Equivalence Classes
hints.text: Two indices belong to the same valid linear subsequence if and only if their key prices[i] - i is identical.

hints.title: Group Sums
hints.text: Group prices by the key prices[i] - i, sum the prices in each group, and find the maximum sum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) hash map storing accumulated group sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Rearrange equation into prices[i] - i constant invariant.
